subject.title: feat(cli): add experimental Antigravity agy backend

question: Should OpenClaw take first-party bundled ownership of this limited preview Antigravity provider, or require it to ship as an external plugin while the broader replacement request remains open?
rationale: Existing plugin seams fully support the implementation, VISION.md defaults optional integrations to external ownership, and accepting a partial provider as bundled support creates product expectations that code review cannot authorize.

options.title: External narrow plugin
options.body: Publish this delegated-inference provider independently with explicit stateless, argv, model, and tool limitations, while keeping https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/84527 open.

options.title: Bundle after sponsorship
options.body: Land it as experimental only after an owner accepts ongoing upstream maintenance and exact-head behavior is proven.

options.title: Expand to canonical replacement
options.body: Redesign the work around migration, session, fallback, structured-output, and compatibility requirements before first-party bundling.

recommendation.title: External narrow plugin
recommendation.body: Publish this delegated-inference provider independently with explicit stateless, argv, model, and tool limitations, while keeping https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/84527 open.

likelyOwner.reason: This person is the current assigned reviewer and therefore the best available owner for routing the specific bundled-versus-external decision.
